commands.assertions: Portal catalog tests preserve healthy sources during provider failure, retain ambiguity until exact identity is selected, expire cached readiness, reject forged owners, preserve headless terminal inventory, and avoid inventing local companion identity.
38 Portal surface/session/flow UI tests pass, including stale selection, failed refresh retention, authenticated session admission, stop fencing, and flow binding.

assertions: Healthy catalog entries survive an unavailable provider and the source reports a bounded failure state.
Display-label ambiguity returns all matches and does not guess an actuator.
Expired capability facts project as unknown without mutating provider-owned cache data.
Forged owner descriptors are rejected and arbitrary provider error details do not cross the projection boundary.
A terminal catalog does not become a desktop or implicitly identify the Portal API host as the companion host.
limitations: CAT-04 multi-transport joining and CAT-08 attached-device topology remain unverified.
These are focused producer tests, not a claim that all five native platform rows are supported.
